github.description: GitHub integration for PRs, issues, and workflow runs

PostToolUse.prompt: Auto-format the edited file if a language-specific formatter is available (gofmt for Go, rustfmt for Rust, black/ruff for Python, prettier for JS/TS/JSON, phpcs for PHP, clang-format for C/C#, google-java-format for Java). Run the appropriate formatter on the changed file. If the formatter is not installed, skip silently.

If the edited file is part of the multi-lang SDK (under multi-lang/), run cross-language verification: cd multi-lang && python3 cross_lang_verify.py. If the edited file is a verification script (under tools/ or multi-lang/tools/), run deep accuracy analysis: cd multi-lang && python3 accuracy_analysis.py. If the edited file is FORMAT.md, run the full verification suite: cd multi-lang && ./run_all.sh.

PreToolUse.prompt: Block edits to .env files, lock files (package-lock.json, Cargo.lock, go.sum), and .qzdb database files. Require explicit user confirmation before proceeding.
